newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALL.

text.p: Stock turnover and traded volume fell at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover shrank to 281,313 denars from 1.215 million denars at the previous session on Thursday as 151 shares traded, down from 456.
Only Gradski Targovski Centar AD shares traded on the first floor, selling 515 units at 1,863 denars, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,662 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week.
